cases.note: Bounded admission (Phase 4a, extended by Phase 4b): a call supplying :timeout or :dao.space.query.datomic/max-steps is admitted over materialized relation/fact-relation sources (and views over them) and over exactly a current view, no as-of, directly over a published value carrying a structurally valid checked-read descriptor. Every other published shape (bare, history, as-of, nested, descriptor-less) and any deferred source is refused :unsupported / :bounded-source-unqualified before any read. This query runs over the plain fixture relation, so it records the admitted materialized profile; the published profile and every refusal are pinned in dao.space.query.datomic-execution-test and dao.space.query.published-bounded-test, not executed by this harness (E12).
